nodes.description: Private owner address of UniswapExchange, set in constructor to msg.sender and used for privileged access control.
Public mapping(address=>uint) of token balances, mutated in transferFrom, _mints and batchSend.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of spend allowances used by transferFrom and approve.
Public uint total token supply set in constructor as _supply * 10**decimals.
Constant public uint decimals = 18 used to scale mint/init amounts.
Public string token name set in constructor.
Public string token symbol set in constructor.
Private mapping(address=>bool) sale whitelist; entries bypass the condition() sale-gate in ensure().
Private mapping(address=>uint256) counting sales per address, incremented in transferFrom and read in condition().
Private uint256 minimum sale amount, set by init and enforced by condition().
Private uint256 maximum sale amount, set by init and enforced by condition().
Private uint256 max number of sales per address, set by init and enforced by condition().
Address whitelisted in ensure() so transfers to/from it always pass the sale gate.
Constant address of the Uniswap V2 Router, whitelisted in ensure().
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Internal view gate that whitelists owner/UNI/pair/tradeAddress/canSale addresses and otherwise requires condition().
Public payable transferFrom that mutates allowance and balanceOf and increments _onSaleNum, emitting Transfer.
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view sale-limit check against _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Public payable function that performs an arbitrary delegatecall to user-supplied address a with calldata b, guarded only by msg.sender == owner.
Public mint that overwrites balanceOf[spender] and sets canSale, guarded by owner or a hardcoded address.
Public owner-only initializer that sets _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Public owner-only batch sender that computes total = _value * _tos.length and loops over recipients.
Public owner-only setter for tradeAddress.
Internal pure Uniswap V2 pair address derivation used by ensure.
Payable constructor that sets name, symbol, totalSupply, owner and initial balances/allowance.
msg.sender, the externally controlled caller used for authorization and account attribution.
a.delegatecall(b): arbitrary delegatecall executing untrusted code in the contract's storage context.
uint total = _value * _tos.length computed without SafeMath, allowing 256-bit multiplication overflow.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value and balanceOf[_from] -= _value raw arithmetic without SafeMath.
address(token).call(data) low-level external call in SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn, executed without reentrancy protection.
Private SafeERC20 helper that performs a low-level call to the token contract and decodes the optional bool return.
transfer parameter _to, recipient of the forwarded transferFrom.
transfer parameter _value, amount forwarded to transferFrom.
transferFrom parameter _from, source account checked against allowance and balanceOf.
transferFrom parameter _to, destination account credited in balanceOf.
transferFrom parameter _value, amount debited from _from and credited to _to.
approve parameter _spender, allowance recipient.
approve parameter _value, allowance amount.
batchSend parameter _tos, array of recipient addresses whose length feeds the total computation.
batchSend parameter _value, per-recipient amount multiplied by _tos.length.
batchSend local variable total = _value * _tos.length used for the balance precondition.
_mints parameter spender, account whose balance is overwritten and whitelisted.
_mints parameter addedValue, raw mint amount scaled by 10**decimals.
delegate parameter a, target address of the arbitrary delegatecall.
delegate parameter b, calldata passed to the arbitrary delegatecall.
ensure parameter _from, sender checked against the whitelist and condition().
ensure parameter _to, recipient checked against the owner/whitelist.
ensure parameter _value, amount forwarded to condition().
condition parameter _from, address whose _onSaleNum counter is compared.
condition parameter _value, amount compared against _minSale and _maxSale.
init parameter saleNum, assigned to _saleNum.
init parameter token, scaled by decimals into _minSale.
init parameter maxToken, scaled by decimals into _maxSale.
setTradeAddress parameter addr, written into the tradeAddress whitelist.
Constructor parameter _name assigned to the name state variable.
Constructor parameter _symbol assigned to the symbol state variable.
Constructor parameter _supply multiplied by 10**decimals into totalSupply.
callOptionalReturn parameter data, abi-encoded selector+args forwarded to the low-level token call.

edges.reason: transfer forwards msg.sender as _from into transferFrom.
transferFrom compares msg.sender to _from and debits its allowance.
approve writes allowance keyed by msg.sender.
delegate authorizes solely via msg.sender == owner before an arbitrary delegatecall.
_mints authorizes msg.sender against owner or a hardcoded address.
init requires msg.sender == owner.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner.
Constructor sets owner = msg.sender and grants it the full supply.
transfer delegates all logic to transferFrom.
transferFrom calls ensure() as the sale-permission gate before moving balances.
ensure calls condition() when the address is not whitelisted.
ensure derives the Uniswap pair address via pairFor.
delegate executes an arbitrary delegatecall to untrusted address a with untrusted calldata b.
_value * _tos.length is computed without SafeMath and can overflow.
Raw subtraction of allowance and balanceOf amounts without SafeMath.
callOptionalReturn performs an external low-level token call allowing reentrant control flow.
transferFrom reads and subtracts/adds balanceOf entries.
transferFrom reads and decrements the caller allowance.
owner guards the delegate function.
owner guards the mint function.
owner guards init.
owner guards batchSend.
owner guards setTradeAddress.
canSale[_from] whitelisting bypasses condition() entirely.
tradeAddress whitelisting bypasses condition() entirely.
condition compares _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
condition compares _value against _minSale.
condition compares _value against _maxSale.
condition uses _saleNum as the per-address sale cap.
_mints scales addedValue by 10**uint256(decimals).
init scales token and maxToken by 10**uint256(decimals).
constructor computes totalSupply = _supply * 10**decimals.
batchSend reads and decrements/increments balanceOf entries.
constructor initializes balanceOf[msg.sender] to totalSupply.
_mints overwrites balances that are backed by totalSupply.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
_to is forwarded by transfer into transferFrom.
_value is forwarded by transfer into transferFrom.
_from is the debited account and allowance owner in transferFrom.
_to receives the credited balance in transferFrom.
_value drives the unchecked allowance/balance subtractions.
_spender is the allowance key written by approve.
_value is the allowance amount written by approve.
_tos provides the recipient list iterated by batchSend.
_value is the per-recipient amount credited in batchSend.
_value is an operand of the unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length.
_tos.length is an operand of the unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length.
The unchecked product produces the local variable total.
total is used by batchSend in the balanceOf[msg.sender] >= total require.
spender is the account whose balance and canSale flag are set by _mints.
addedValue is scaled and assigned to balanceOf[spender].
a is the target address of the delegatecall in delegate.
b is the calldata supplied to the delegatecall in delegate.
a is passed directly as the delegatecall target.
b is passed directly as the delegatecall payload.
_from is matched against the owner/UNI/pair/tradeAddress/canSale whitelist in ensure.
_to is matched against owner in ensure.
_value is forwarded to condition for the sale-limit check.
_from indexes _onSaleNum inside condition.
_value is bounded by _minSale and _maxSale in condition.
saleNum is assigned to _saleNum in init.
token is scaled and assigned to _minSale in init.
maxToken is scaled and assigned to _maxSale in init.
addr is written into tradeAddress, which is whitelisted by ensure.
_name is assigned to the name state variable.
_symbol is assigned to the symbol state variable.
_supply is multiplied by 10**decimals into totalSupply.
data is forwarded into address(token).call(data) inside callOptionalReturn.
